speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. To better understand your double vision and muscle weakness, have you noticed any difficulty with speech, swallowing, or your handwriting?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: The fluctuating weakness and specific eye movement issues suggest myasthenia gravis; have you experienced any drooping of your eyelids or worsening of symptoms later in the day? REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_receptor_antibodies
